answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports the objective because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 provides strong evidence through enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, though realized revenue and durability are omitted. Memory 73 shows acquisition and revenue lift, but omits margin, retention, customer quality, and post-promotion durability. Memories 31 and 86 demonstrate durable or meaningful improvements in activation and adoption, but only through proximal product metrics rather than qualified revenue. Memory 91 is weakest because it cites early engagement and a vaguely defined meaningful action without evidence of revenue quality, retention, or long-term impact.
